data.title: 青山七海 · 寒风车站的共围一条围巾
data.description: 冬夜打工结束后的路灯下雪花轻舞，七海双手呵着白气。当你将红白针织围巾分出一半轻轻绕在她颈间时，马尾少女微微一愣，随即眉眼弯弯，悄悄把冰凉的小手塞进你的大衣口袋。
data.location: snowy winter street corner under a warm streetlamp
data.action: standing close sharing a woolen scarf, hands tucked together into partner coat pocket, smiling radiantly with flushed cheeks under falling snow
data.lighting: warm golden streetlamp casting soft glow on drifting snowflakes
data.mood: romantic winter tenderness, heartwarming intimacy, unconditional lover bond
data.promptProse: Under a snowy streetlamp at night, Nanami Aoyama shares a wool scarf with partner, tucking hands into his pocket with a tender radiant smile.
data.animaCaption: Nanami Aoyama sharing warm scarf lovingly under snowy streetlamp.
